verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a coding agent with a CLI and cloud service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking or any opt-out setting. The pack covers MCP, the Adaptive model router, environments and the API, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
